summary: Automatic family seat selection. Finds seats together for a travelling party and moves everyone in one step.

inputs.name: flight_id
inputs.description: The flight the reservation is on, e.g. NA214.

inputs.name: reservation_code
inputs.description: The confirmation code of the party's reservation.

inputs.name: passengers
inputs.description: Passenger ids of the party to seat together, in the reservation's order.

app_state.name: seat_map
app_state.description: Every row and seat with its live state: available, booked, blocked or occupied by this party.

app_state.name: available_seats
app_state.description: Seat ids a passenger could take right now.

app_state.name: restrictions
app_state.description: Per passenger: type, age, whether an exit row is allowed, whether they must sit with an adult.

app_state.name: seat_prices
app_state.description: Price in cents per seat id; zero for a standard seat.

constraints: the aisle sits between C and D

actions.name: get_seat_map
actions.description: Read the whole cabin with the state of every seat.

actions.name: get_available_seats
actions.description: The ids of every seat a passenger could take right now.

actions.name: get_passenger_restrictions
actions.description: What one passenger may and may not do: exit rows, sitting apart from an adult.

actions.name: calculate_seat_price
actions.description: What one seat costs, in cents.

actions.name: rank_seat_groups
actions.description: Order every valid group of adjacent seats by the preferences: lowest added cost first, children beside an adult.

actions.name: assign_seat
actions.description: Move one passenger to one seat. Atomic and idempotent; there is no bulk form.

constraints.statement: Every seat in the group is in the same row.
The seats are contiguous, with no empty seat and no other passenger between them.
Seats on opposite sides of the aisle are not adjacent. A group never spans the aisle.
Only seats that are available at the time of the call are used. A seat the party already holds counts as available to the party.
A seat held out of service for accessible seating is never used.
A child is never placed in an exit row. A passenger who must sit with an adult is placed next to one.
Applying a result moves every passenger or none. If one move fails, the passengers that were already moved return to their previous seats.
Only passengers of the given reservation can be moved. Anyone else is refused.

preferences.statement: Prefer the group with the lowest added cost over the party's current seats.
Prefer groups where each child sits directly beside an adult of the party.
Prefer the party's current seats when they already satisfy every constraint.

final_state.statement: After applying the result, every passenger of the party sits in one contiguous group in one row, on one side of the aisle.
The applied seats satisfy every constraint at the moment of applying them.
The result states the added cost in cents before anything is applied.

scenarios.given: a party of one adult and two children in 12A, 18C and 24F, and row 21 A, B and C available
scenarios.when: the party asks for seats together
scenarios.then: the result is 21A, 21B and 21C with an added cost of 0

scenarios.given: a row where only C and D are available, on opposite sides of the aisle, and a party of two
scenarios.when: the party asks for seats together
scenarios.then: that row is not offered as a group

scenarios.given: no row with three contiguous available seats on one side
scenarios.when: a party of three asks for seats together
scenarios.then: the result says no group is available and every passenger keeps their seat

scenarios.given: the only three-seat run in a row includes the blocked accessible seat
scenarios.when: a party of three asks for seats together
scenarios.then: that run is not offered and the blocked seat is never assigned

scenarios.given: the only available three-seat runs are in exit rows and the party includes a child
scenarios.when: the party asks for seats together
scenarios.then: no exit row is offered and the result says no group is available

scenarios.given: a party of three adults and an available three-seat run in an exit row
scenarios.when: the party asks for seats together
scenarios.then: the exit row may be offered, with its price as the added cost

scenarios.given: a result of 21A, 21B and 21C, and 21B taken by another booking before the party applies it
scenarios.when: the party applies the result
scenarios.then: the apply fails with a seat-taken reason and every passenger of the party is back in their original seat

scenarios.given: one passenger already holds a paid extra-legroom seat and the offered group is in a standard row
scenarios.when: the party asks for seats together
scenarios.then: the added cost is 0 and the result notes the seat that is given up

scenarios.given: a party of one adult and two children and a three-seat run
scenarios.when: the party asks for seats together
scenarios.then: the adult is assigned the middle seat so each child sits beside the adult

scenarios.given: a party of one adult and one child and two two-seat runs, one of which would leave the child beside a stranger
scenarios.when: the party asks for seats together
scenarios.then: the child is assigned the seat beside the adult

scenarios.given: a result that has been applied once
scenarios.when: the same result is applied again
scenarios.then: nobody moves, nothing is charged twice, and the apply reports success

scenarios.given: a passenger id that belongs to a different reservation
scenarios.when: the party asks for seats together including that passenger
scenarios.then: the request is refused with a permission reason and nobody moves

scenarios.given: a party of one passenger
scenarios.when: the passenger asks for seats together
scenarios.then: the result is the passenger's current seat with an added cost of 0 and no move is needed

scenarios.given: a party of four in a 3-3 cabin
scenarios.when: the party asks for seats together
scenarios.then: the result says no group is available, because a group never spans the aisle

scenarios.given: 21C and 22A available and nothing else contiguous
scenarios.when: a party of two asks for seats together
scenarios.then: 21C and 22A are not offered together

scenarios.given: a free standard row and a paid bulkhead row that both fit the party
scenarios.when: the party asks for seats together
scenarios.then: the standard row is offered first with an added cost of 0

scenarios.given: a party already seated in 21A, 21B and 21C
scenarios.when: the party asks for seats together
scenarios.then: the result is the current seats with an added cost of 0 and no move is needed

scenarios.given: a seat that was available and then taken by another booking
scenarios.when: the party asks for seats together after the change
scenarios.then: the result contains only seats that are available at that moment

scenarios.given: a result of 21A, 21B and 21C for a party in 12A, 18C and 24F
scenarios.when: the party applies the result
scenarios.then: the seat map shows the three passengers in 21A, 21B and 21C

scenarios.given: a result applied for a party that held 12A, 18C and 24F
scenarios.when: the seat map is read again
scenarios.then: 12A, 18C and 24F are available

scenarios.given: the capability's API route
scenarios.when: it is called with a malformed body, or with a reservation that does not exist
scenarios.then: it answers 400 for the malformed body and 404 for the unknown reservation, and nobody moves

proposed_ui.label: Find seats together
proposed_ui.result_summary: We found 3 seats together: 21A, 21B, 21C. Additional cost: $0. One action, Move everyone, applies it.
